test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

Will the company launch the new product?

options.text: The new product will be launched by the company?
Will the new product be launched by the company?
Is the new product launched by the company?
The new product would be launched by the company?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Will the company launch the new product?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the new product" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will launch" to "
